shortBulletSummary: US Senate blocks CLARITY Act, causing industry disappointment over failed crypto regulation.
Crypto market tumbles with Bitcoin falling to ~$75,000 and surging liquidations following the CLARITY Act failure.
Fed rate decision awaited today, which is expected to impact market volatility.
Geopolitical tensions, rising oil prices, and inflation concerns continue to pressure risk assets.
Bitcoin and Ethereum spot ETFs recorded significant net outflows on September 15th.
